blocks.text: Kim Chiu broke her silence on the legal battle between her and her older sister, Lakam Chiu, clarifying that it was “never about personal money” but the business she worked so hard to build. Lakam faces 124 counts of qualified theft over alleged unauthorized withdrawals and transfers involving about ₱44.4 million in company funds from the sisters’ handbag business. “I do not know where to start po. Sobrang nasasaktan po ako.
